entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [MAUI 10] Layout breaks on first navigation (Shell // route) until soft keyboard appears/disappears (Android + iOS) #33038
  • iOS Large Title display disappears #33037
  • SafeAreaEdges works correctly only on the first tab in Shell. Other tabs have content colliding with the display cutout in the landscape mode. #33034
  • SearchBar stopped working on iOS physical device #33033
  • [.NET 10] AndroidLinkMode=SdkOnly crashes on startup with "only_unmanaged_callers_only" assertion (icall.c:6261) #33032

Closed

  • iOS ScrollView/CollectionView do not start scrolling when touch begins on Button or item (regression from MAUI 9 → MAUI 10) #32852

PullRequests

Created

  • Enable XAML Source Generator on ManualTests project #33036
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [Android] Reset content margin on TabbedPage disappearing without removing tabs #33031

Updated

  • [Agents] uitest-coding-agent- improvements #33021
    community ✨, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [iOS] Fixed Using safe area causes white area at the top upon entry focus #26063
    area-layout, platform/ios, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [Android] Fixed Label Overlapped by Android Status Bar When Using SafeAreaEdges="Container" in .NET MAUI #33014
    platform/android, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, area-safearea
  • [Testing] Rework Catalyst Test Runner to use startup arguments instead of UI navigation #31673
    p/0, area-testing, community ✨, testing-infrastructure, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [Android] Prevent tabs from being removed during Disappearing #32878
    .NET 10.0 SR2
